description: Coordinate FreeSurfer anatomical atlas parcellation, cortical surface reconstruction, subcortical segmentation and associated volume/surface operations. recon-all exposes both the subject directory and stage-specific files, including aparc+aseg.mgz for cortical/subcortical brain regions. Select individual Methods or matching Pipelines; check structural-to-diffusion alignment separately before connectome construction.

method_refs.label: FreeSurfer recon-all（可执行）
method_refs.default_reason: Choose for anatomical atlas parcellation or cortical/subcortical reconstruction when T1w or a suitable existing FreeSurfer subject is available. Verify stage, space and runtime status; availability is not a completed run.
method_refs.role: Run FreeSurfer recon-all for T1w cortical surface reconstruction, subcortical segmentation and anatomical atlas parcellation. all runs the full reconstruction; autorecon1/2/3 are consecutive stages, and stats recomputes statistics in an existing subject directory. all/autorecon3 expose mri/aparc+aseg.mgz as a Desikan-Killiany cortical plus subcortical node image, not just a result folder. Labels are in the subject structural space, not automatically aligned to DWI or streamlines. Connectome use requires checking alignment and the atlas lookup table; labelconvert remaps IDs but does not register images. Tissue segmentation, 5TT and data-driven clusters are different products.
